exposure: Patients infected during each COVID-19 wave
Patients infected with different SARS-CoV-2 variants
cohort: 8,983 patients who delivered at a single academic medical center in the Bronx, New York, between March 1, 2020, and February 13, 2022
finding: There was a general trend toward improvement in preterm birth rates across the COVID-19 pandemic among pregnant patients with SARS-CoV-2 infection, and while the Omicron variant was more infectious, the preterm birth rate during the Omicron wave was low compared with that during the original wave and the Alpha wave.
